is-0vwU.title: Google car: blurred red or white pickup
is-0vwU.summary: Gen 4 coverage was taken with red and white pickup trucks, both heavily blurred.

is-1WGJ.title: Sign: yellow-background warning signs
is-1WGJ.summary: Warning signs have a yellow background. Sweden and Finland do the same.

is-1Yf4.title: Landscape: one flat-ridge mountain on flat land
is-1Yf4.summary: Around a southern town, a distinctive mountain with a flat ridge stands over otherwise flat land and can be seen from far away.

is-3eR6.title: Landscape: fjords with big jagged mountains
is-3eR6.summary: In the far east: several fjords, but with larger and more jagged mountains than in the north-west.

is-4Z9g.title: Landscape: barren, treeless, dark volcanic soil
is-4Z9g.summary: Often barren and treeless, with dark grey soil made mostly of volcanic rock. It looks unlike anywhere else in northern Europe.

is-88qE.title: Landscape: narrow fjords, flat-topped mountains
is-88qE.summary: In the north-west: many narrow fjords with moderately tall, mostly flat-topped mountains around them.

is-8Ms8.title: Landscape: ragged cliffs over a harbour town
is-8Ms8.summary: An island recognisable by ragged rocky cliffs above its town. Similar cliffs show on the small islands off the coast.

is-9uH4.title: City: valley town with mountains both sides
is-9uH4.summary: The second biggest city sits in a north-south valley on the west edge of a bay, with mountain ranges to the east and west.

is-AbV1.title: Coverage: very foggy
is-AbV1.summary: Very foggy coverage in the north-east around one small town. The fog is visible from a distance too.

is-C9oY.title: Route numbers: first digit shows region
is-C9oY.summary: On yellow direction signs, road number 1 is the ring road around the island. For other roads the first digit is a region, going clockwise from 2 in the south up to 9.

is-CG6f.title: Google car: red truck south-west, white north-east
is-CG6f.summary: The country splits by pickup colour: red in the south-west, white in the north-east.

is-Et2D.title: Bollard: yellow post, white reflector
is-Et2D.summary: Yellow bollards with a white reflector. Extremely common on almost every rural road.

is-F8Gs.title: Street sign: white, black text, thin rim
is-F8Gs.summary: White street signs with black text and often a thin metal rim, fixed to lampposts or traffic lights.

is-JAin.title: Landscape: wide hilly farm valley, snowy peaks
is-JAin.summary: A wide, slightly hilly farm valley with tall snowy peaks in the distance on both sides, to the east and north-west.

is-JmkG.title: Language: ð, þ, æ and accented vowels
is-JmkG.summary: Special letters ð, þ and æ, plus accented vowels á é í ó ö ú ý. The Faroese language also has ð, and æ appears in Danish, Norwegian and Faroese.

differs.how: Faroese uses ø and lacks þ, é and ö

is-T5Vc.title: Landscape: rugged volcanic scenery
is-T5Vc.summary: A very volcanically active land, so look for rugged mountains, geothermal lakes, lava fields, rift valleys and towering rock formations.

is-VW5n.title: Landscape: dark volcanic gravel, no life
is-VW5n.summary: Inland: barren dark volcanic gravel with almost no plants. Most covered roads like this are in the east.

is-VkQ5.title: Road: divided or multi-lane highway, very rare
is-VkQ5.summary: Only a handful of highways are divided or have three or more lanes. Exceptions: divided roads inside towns other than the capital, and short divided bits near junctions.

is-WZXG.title: Coverage: sparse, dense in the southwest
is-WZXG.summary: Coverage is sparse. The southwest is densest and only a few interior roads are covered.

is-X4vj.title: Sign: yellow direction signs, white number box
is-X4vj.summary: Yellow direction signs, usually with a white box showing road numbers. A dashed box border means the number is a nearby road, not yours. Local farm signs are blue or white.

is-Z7Bu.title: Road lines: all white, no yellow
is-Z7Bu.summary: All-white road lines, with outer lines solid or rarely dashed. There are no yellow lines. Yellow lines in a Nordic setting point to Norway or Finland.

is-bPcD.title: Google car: white car, long antenna
is-bPcD.summary: The Gen 3 car is white with a long antenna.

is-gEmJ.title: City: biggest city, flat, on a bay
is-gEmJ.summary: The capital is by far the largest city: mostly flat with slight hills, on the south side of a bay, with a big-city feel. The second city can feel urban too but has mountains to its east and west.

is-gVuJ.title: Landscape: wooded valley with wide river
is-gVuJ.summary: A valley running north-east to south-west with low mountains, a wide river and, unusually for the country, plenty of trees. Some side roads run through forest.

is-hgBk.title: Landscape: snowy peaks and north-facing valleys
is-hgBk.summary: West of the biggest northern town: valleys squeezed between tall, often snowcapped peaks, most facing north to north-east.

is-lm-444188.title: Road: divided highway southwest of the capital
is-lm-444188.summary: Roads 41 and 43 southwest of the capital, and road 1 between Grundarhverfi and Selfoss, are divided.

is-lm-444189.title: Road: multi-lane tunnel approach
is-lm-444189.summary: Both ends of the Hvalfjördur Tunnel have several lanes in one direction.

is-oi9u.title: Chevron: black with yellow arrows
is-oi9u.summary: Black chevrons with yellow arrows. Norway and Finland look the same. Sweden has unique blue and yellow chevrons.

differs.how: Swedish chevrons are blue and yellow

is-pJN0.title: Landscape: glaciers reaching toward the sea
is-pJN0.summary: On the south coast, big glaciers are visible from the ring road, spilling toward the sea from a huge ice cap.

is-sZf3.title: Sign: pedestrian sign, four stripes, yellow tint
is-sZf3.summary: Pedestrian signs show four stripes and often a slight yellow tint. It is the only European country with a yellow pedestrian sign.

is-tHAX.title: Plate: all white, blue letters, no blue strip
is-tHAX.summary: Fully white plates with blue characters and no blue strip on the left, unlike most of Europe. The blue letters can be hard to see through the blur.

is-wz9a.title: Landscape: flat farmland, distant mountains
is-wz9a.summary: In the south-west: fairly flat farmland dotted with farmsteads, fields and meadows. The mountains here sit far away, which is unusual.
